title: Noticias de la costa
brief: You're Tomás at the café. Don Hernando has news and he's older than you, so use usted. Show interest, ask what it's about, pass a request along and ask one careful question.

turns.npc: Tomás, tengo noticias de la costa.
turns.npcEn: Tomás, I have news from the coast.
turns.intent: Show interest and ask what it is about.

require.label: ask what it is about: ¿De qué se trata?

turns.npc: Un primo de un amigo mío conoce a un pescador de Taganga. Su abuelo se llamaba Herrera.
turns.npcEn: A cousin of a friend of mine knows a fisherman in Taganga. His grandfather was called Herrera.
turns.intent: You can't believe the name. Echo his last sentence, putting the question word where the surprise is: His grandfather was called what?

require.label: put the question word last: ¿Se llamaba cómo?

turns.npc: Herrera, sí señor. Se llama Jairo, y su hija Marisol tiene el celular. ¿Qué le digo a mi amigo?
turns.npcEn: Herrera, yes sir. His name is Jairo, and his daughter Marisol has the phone. What should I tell my friend?
turns.intent: Ask him to tell his friend to pass you Marisol's number.
accept: Dígale a su amigo que me pase el número de Marisol.
Por favor, dígale que me dé el número de Marisol.
Dígale que me pase el número, por favor.

require.label: pass on a request: dígale que me pase

turns.npc: Hecho. Marisol trabaja en un hotel, creo.
turns.npcEn: Done. Marisol works in a hotel, I think.
turns.intent: Ask politely if he happens to know whether the hotel is near the beach.
accept: ¿Por casualidad sabe si el hotel queda cerca de la playa?
Una pregunta: ¿por casualidad sabe si queda cerca de la playa?
¿Sabe por casualidad si el hotel está cerca de la playa?

turns.npc: No sé, pero mañana se lo pregunto. ¿Le sirvo un tinto?
turns.npcEn: I don't know, but I'll ask him tomorrow. Shall I pour you a coffee?
turns.intent: Accept the coffee and thank him.
accept: Sí, gracias, don Hernando. Un tinto me cae bien.
Con gusto, gracias. Me hace falta uno.
